name: Amethyst Stalker · Diamond style
role: Boss style · Ring 3 Crystal islands with diamond nodes · same abilities
notes: Same rig, bones, animations and hitbox as the Amethyst Stalker; only textures and added boxes change.
Pale silver-white fur like a snow leopard, diamond-blue crystals, and two extra diamond spikes on the shoulders.
The splinter and eyes stay violet, which stands out strongly against the pale body.
Spawns on Crystal islands that have diamond nodes; the rarest Stalker style.
